description: This is a Go test source file containing integration tests for user-related functionalities in the focalboard server, including registration, login, user retrieval, password change, and file upload permissions.

methods.name: TestUserRegister
methods.description: Tests user registration including duplicate registration failure.

methods.name: TestUserLogin
methods.description: Tests login with non-existent and registered users.

methods.name: TestGetMe
methods.description: Tests retrieving current user info when not logged in and when logged in.

methods.name: TestGetUser
methods.description: Tests retrieving user details by ID and handling non-existent user.

methods.name: TestGetUserList
methods.description: Tests retrieving user lists with different roles and permissions, including board membership scenarios.

methods.name: randomBytes
methods.description: Generates random byte array for testing file uploads.

methods.name: TestTeamUploadFile
methods.description: Tests file upload permissions and functionality for team boards.
